annotation.title_clean: Spotkanie członków Koalicji AI i innowacji w zdrowiu z Prezesem UODO
annotation.title_en: Meeting of members of the AI and Innovation in Health Coalition with the President of UODO
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych (UODO), Departament Komunikacji Społecznej
annotation.summary_en: News item from Poland's data protection authority (UODO) reporting a 29 November 2024 meeting between the UODO President and the AI in Health Coalition on patient data processing, anonymisation, training medical AI models, and the relation of NIS2, DORA and the AI Act to data protection.
key_provisions_or_claims: UODO and Coalition discussed use of medical data for training AI models
Topics included anonymisation and pseudonymisation standards for medical data
NIS2, DORA and their relation to the AI Act were discussed
UODO says it supports personal data protection guarantees in health-sector law
Medical sector representatives asked about complaints concerning AI processing of medical data
